name: CVF Engineering Planning Task Breakdown
owner: CVF ASSF registry and planning governance surface
purpose: Help future CVF planning split a requested task into bounded, source-verified work units with explicit activation, defer, and evidence boundaries.
useWhen: A roadmap, work order, or candidate lane needs to be split into bounded tasks with source evidence, sequencing, and stop conditions.
doNotUseWhen: The user asks for a simple direct answer, the task has already been dispatched, or planning would reopen a closed lane without a recorded reopen condition.
riskTriggers: closed lane may be reopened accidentally
executionConstraints: metadata-only candidate; does not authorize planning output as execution authority without a governed work order
acceptanceEvidence: future promotion requires package instance evidence and reviewer proof that planning reduces scope drift
authorityCeiling: metadata-only planning guidance; cannot create or execute a tranche without normal CVF authorization
permissions: read metadata and cited governed source artifacts only
rollback: delete this registry entry and regenerate the skill index if reviewer rejects AGSK-T7
safeStop: if dependencies or reopen conditions are unclear, mark the task blocked instead of dispatching
capabilityBoundary: no package body, no SKILL.md, no runtime resolver, no checker wiring, no automatic dispatch
resolverBehavior: metadata-only; resolver returns identity and selector fields; does not open any SKILL.md or instruction body
loaderBoundary: loading this metadata never grants authority to execute a plan, dispatch work, or reopen a closed lane
adapterContract: N/A with reason: external CLI/MCP adapter not authored in AGSK-T7
adapterEvidence: N/A with reason: no adapter implemented in AGSK-T7
externalMutationBoundary: no external mutation permitted until a separate ASSF adapter work order is accepted
shellAssumptions: no shell execution required for metadata-only candidate
